result.rationale: The diff line `[z.string().toString()]: z.number(),` uses a computed property with a ZodType object coerced to string, yielding the literal key "[object Object]" (or similar), not an arbitrary/any-key matcher. minimumTokenResponseSchema therefore requires access_token plus that literal property, so valid token responses (e.g. Google's with expiry_date, O365's with expires_in) fail validation when APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED is on, breaking token refresh and credential persistence. Correctness defect introduced by the new file.
